title: Check: Greenhouse Gases and Climate Change (2)

questions.stem: What is the difference between the natural greenhouse effect and the enhanced greenhouse effect?

options.text: The natural greenhouse effect uses different gases than the enhanced effect
The natural effect keeps Earth habitable, while the enhanced effect is caused by human activities increasing greenhouse gas levels beyond natural balance
The enhanced greenhouse effect only affects cities, not rural areas
There is no difference; they describe the same process

questions.explanation: The natural greenhouse effect is essential for life, keeping Earth at about 15 degrees C. The enhanced greenhouse effect is the additional warming caused by human activities (burning fossil fuels, agriculture, deforestation) increasing greenhouse gas concentrations beyond their natural levels, leading to climate change.
